snippet.title: Euro Truck Simulator 2: Introducing Soul of Anatolia
snippet.description:
We are excited to introduce the Soul of Anatolia DLC! This upcoming map expansion for Euro Truck Simulator 2 will take you to the heart of Türkiye, from the bustling streets of Istanbul all the way to Aksaray!

Add it to your Steam wishlist here 👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/4400930/

Read more about this DLC 👉 https://blog.scssoft.com/2026/04/introducing-soul-of-anatolia.html
